versions.changelog:
Initial release: Expert, brand-neutral mechanical keyboard buying consultant.

- Introduces a guided, question-based consultation to determine ideal keyboard specs based on user context, not brand or marketing.
- Covers all critical decision factors: switch type, actuation force, noise level, layout/form factor, connectivity, platform compatibility, build quality, customisation, and regional standards.
- Ensures unbiased, structured recommendations with clear priority given to user-stated needs.
- Excludes troubleshooting, repair, and guidance unrelated to purchasing decisions.
